raw_text: GeoConfirmed analysis: breach location geolocated to 46.7708N, 33.3756E matching the central spillway gates. Pre-breach structural degradation visible in open-source satellite imagery from May 28. Water flow analysis using Sentinel-1 SAR data shows flood front advancing at 2-3 km/hr downstream. Agricultural irrigation canal system completely disrupted.
clean_text: Breach geolocated to 46.7708N 33.3756E at central spillway. Pre-breach structural degradation visible from May 28 imagery. Flood front advancing 2-3 km/hr. Irrigation system disrupted.
